title: Kyler Murray: I've never had an issue protecting myself, concussion was an awkward play

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kyler Murray: I've never had an issue protecting myself, concussion was an awkward play
sources.description: Kyler Murray will be back at quarterback for the Vikings when they take on the Buccaneers this Sunday and he won't be playing with fears of a repeat of what happened in Week 1.
